question: A fictional learner finishes one patient encounter and prepares to begin another. Which action supports Standard Precautions?
option_a: Perform hand hygiene as indicated before the next encounter
option_b: Use the same gloves for both encounters
option_c: Skip hand hygiene if gloves were worn
option_d: Clean hands only when dirt is visible
rationale: Standard Precautions include hand hygiene. Wearing gloves does not replace indicated hand hygiene, and gloves must not be carried between patient encounters.
